svg.title: same-names-b: Logo/Bogo/Fogo are this document's fonts, not A's
svg.text: Same CSS names as same-names-a.svg (Logo, Bogo, Fogo). Each document binds those names to different files.
Pass: this window is pixel / brush / blackletter. A must stay script / spooky / geometric.
Fail: A and B look the same, or these samples match the sans captions. Font dialog will not list Logo.
